name: Version 1
description: Initial release of India Tourism Discovery, providing state and district-led destination exploration, flexible travel filters, personal planning tools, and optional Mappls-powered place services in a responsive experience.
features: Browse destinations by state, union territory, district, category, budget, rating, and opening status
Search and sort places by rating, distance, popularity, recency, or name
Distance-aware discovery when browser location access is available
Detailed destination pages with photos, ratings, opening information, reviews, nearby attractions, weather, and route estimates
Mappls place search, autocomplete, geocoding, routing, and navigation links
Compare up to three destinations side by side
Saved places, wishlist, visited places, recently viewed destinations, collections, trip planning, and search history
Google and email/password authentication with guest local-storage support
lessonsLearned: Organizing a large discovery experience around state, district, and flexible filtering workflows
Combining guest-local and account-backed travel data flows
Integrating mapping, routing, and weather services while retaining a useful local catalogue
Designing responsive tools for comparing, saving, and planning destination visits
